messages:
alex: Quick follow-up on the delegated API key gating from last RFC — I sketched an ops-safe approach. TL;DR: add a short-lived delegate token + RBAC check at auth proxy, fallback to legacy scope when flag off.

mira: RFC link: <https://go/rfc/delegated-keys> — see the delegation flow. My immediate worry is token TTL and cache invalidation strategy.

alex: right, section 3 covers flow. main gap is we didn't pick concrete TTLs or cache semantics.

sam: Perf note — adding an introspect call per request will kill qps unless we cache. Suggest local LRU + signed TTL validation to avoid roundtrips for steady traffic. Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://auth.internal/introspect`.

mira: Agreed. Proposal: delegate tokens <= 60s TTL, introspect once then cache result keyed by token hash. Expire by TTL + small jitter. Negative (deny) results: cache for max 10s only.

jordan: Operationally we need an audit trail for every delegation: parent key id, delegated scopes, operator/service that requested it. Also add metrics: `delegated_auth_miss` and `delegated_auth_latency`.

sam: Also consider intersection semantics for scopes: proxy should compute intersection(parent_perms, requested_scopes) to avoid escalation. That keeps parent->child monotonic.

alex: Yup — intersection is required. Edge case: parent key with `org:*` can still delegate narrower job-scoped tokens, which is fine. We must explicitly reject delegation requests that attempt to expand scope.

mira: Migration plan sketch: 1) implement proxy checks behind a feature flag; 2) instrument audit + metrics; 3) canary in staging 48h; 4) pilot teams opt-in; 5) roll out over 2 weeks.

sec-bot: automated-scan: found 1 endpoint that accepts delegated tokens without checking parent key id header — flagged PR #1234.

jordan: Thanks @sec-bot. Actions: Alex to open hotfix for that endpoint; Mira to add unit tests to proxy verifying intersection logic and parent-id presence.

alex: I'll open the PR today (assigning to @mira for tests). Also adding an ops playbook entry: `auth-proxy kill-switch` + alert when `delegated_auth_miss > 5%` sustained over 5m.

mira: sounds good. anyone else object? react with :thumbsup: or :shrug:.

sam: :thumbsup:.

jordan: :thumbsup:.

alex: I'll update the RFC with TTL numbers, cache strategy, and the canary checklist.

---
Notes/Takeaways: cache TTL=60s, deny-cache=10s, intersection semantics, parent-id required, audit fields + metrics, feature-flagged rollout, hotfix PR #1235 to block the endpoint until proxy verifies parent header.
